title: Satellite Images Reveal How Suspected Scam Compounds Appear Out of Nowhere
summary: More than two dozen suspected new scam compounds in war-torn Myanmar have been built or expanded significantly in the past six months, according to satellite images and analysis of the area reviewed by WIRED.
